title: "Datafun: a functional query language" by Michael Arntzenius
summary: Michael Arntzenius's Strange Loop talk on Datafun, a functional query language that brings database-style querying into a general-purpose language. It discusses bridging database theory and programming languages.
why: HN recommends it as an approachable talk on a total functional generalization of Datalog, by the language's author.

quote.text: Also be sure to watch Datafun author Michael Arntzenius's Strangeloop talk.
